brand.name: My Revision
brand.tagline: Organize your studies, track your progress, and achieve your goals.

landing.heroTitle: Organize your studies, track your progress, and achieve your goals.
landing.heroSubtitle: A complete academic platform: structure your subjects and lessons, auto-generate your timetable, and monitor your progress day by day — in three languages.
landing.trustedBy: Built for university, prep classes, high school, and any program
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to run your studies
landing.featuresSubtitle: From organizing a subject to the final exam — one platform for your whole journey.
landing.howSubtitle: Six steps between you and a structured timetable with precise tracking.
landing.aboutTitle: Built for students who want a real system
landing.aboutBody: My Revision combines rigorous academic organization with precise daily tracking, turning your study plan into measurable results.
landing.contactSubtitle: A question, suggestion, or issue? We're here to help.
landing.contactSent: Your message has been sent — we'll get back to you soon.
landing.privacyBody: Your data is yours. Academic information is stored in your private workspace and is never visible to another student. You can export your data or delete your account at any time from Settings.
landing.termsBody: By using My Revision you agree to use the platform for personal academic purposes, not to share your credentials, and not to abuse the services. Accounts in violation may be suspended.
landing.step1Body: Sign up with your email and activate your account through the verification link.
landing.step2Body: Enter your academic year, semester and subjects with their details.
landing.step3Body: Split each subject into chapters and lessons with duration and priority.
landing.step4Body: Add your study days and hours plus your maximum daily duration.
landing.step5Body: The smart planner builds a realistic schedule from priorities and exam proximity.
landing.step6Body: Mark completed lessons and watch your percentages and statistics.
landing.footerAbout: A multilingual academic platform for organizing studies and tracking progress.
